sources.title: Fan Chuo: Man shu / Yunnan zhi, bilingual annotated primary text
sources.note: Indexed original bilingual edition, printed100 lines1615 to 1640: noblewomen and servants attire, youths playing gourds/leaves, festivities. Ninth-century Tang outsider, not neutral census. Mirrors under /download/ counted same work.
